svg.title: 1-roll v2 perfboard layout
svg.text: 1-roll v2: perfboard layout (70 × 90 mm dot board, component side)
Modules sit in female headers so they can be swapped. Sensor and fan leads use JST-XH sockets; only 12 V in uses a screw terminal.
Heater current never runs on the board:
14 AWG from TF1 to the heater, heater −
soldered to Q1's drain leg, and Q1's
source leg straight back to J1's black wire.
Keep the HX711s away from Q1 and the
MP1584: their switching adds scale noise.
Wire 3V3 and GND as two bare buses
